Tampa also plays at Columbus on Thursday, so tonight is the first night of a back-to-back. CBS listed Buffalo as a slight home underdog (+106, total 6.5). Puck drop is listed for 7:10 PM EST Wednesday, but outlets disagree: NHL.com says 7 p.m. ET and ESPN says 7:30 PM.
